free_tier.stated: $0 a month with $25 of usage included once, about 500 typical agent hours, 5 running sandboxes at once and a one-hour maximum timeout. Preview pricing is not charged.
free_tier.notes: Usage is in dollars spent at the published meter rates, not a fixed block of time. The hours figure assumes a typical agent sandbox at about $0.05 an hour.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a running microVM sandbox, not a stored object; a per-file cap is not stated on Anona's pricing or limits page.

retention.stated: A running sandbox is deleted at its timeout by default; a paused sandbox keeps its snapshot until the user deletes it and costs $0.03 per GB-month. Paused sandboxes kept on Free: 5.
retention.notes: The free plan's longest timeout is one hour; beyond that a sandbox is deleted unless paused.

egress.terms: The free plan allows no public internet egress. Paid plans allow it by default; private and internal ranges plus cloud metadata are always blocked. Metered at $0.12 per GB when enabled.

interface_detail: E2B-compatible REST gateway at https://api.compute.anonalabs.com; anona-compute CLI with exec, ssh, scp, port forwarding, live view and an MCP server; SDKs for Python and TypeScript; a browser dashboard for sign-in, keys and sandboxes.
tooling: The stock e2b Python and JavaScript SDK packages work against the gateway with E2B_DOMAIN=compute.anonalabs.com; the anona-compute CLI and the anona / @anona-labs/compute-sdk extras add live view and SSH. The CLI is installed on the user's machine; the sandbox itself runs on Anona's hosted platform.
chaining: An E2B-compatible microVM for running agent-written code, with pause and resume so a long agent keeps its memory; because free egress is off, a job that needs network access needs a paid plan or a separate hosted relay.

limits.value: $25 of usage included once on Free, spent at $0.012 per running sandbox-hour, $0.12 per active vCPU-hour, $0.008 per resident GiB-hour and $0.03 per GB-month of snapshot storage
1 hour maximum timeout on Free; a longer timeout or -1 is refused with HTTP 400
5 running sandboxes at once and 5 paused sandboxes kept on Free; creating more answers 429 sandbox_quota_exceeded
Free plan allows no public internet egress; up to 64 allow and 256 deny entries per sandbox

limits_note: Per-sandbox size limits, per-minute create rates and request rates exist in the plans but are not enforced by the gateway yet. Cold starts wait up to 60 s and return 503 with Retry-After: 30 if a server does not start. Preview pricing is not charged.
binding_note: The one-hour timeout and $25 one-time usage are bounded, but with public internet egress off by default the free sandbox cannot fetch anything from the internet, which fails first for any networked agent workload.

identity_cost.detail: Dashboard sign-in is by email magic link or GitHub; onboarding creates an organization. The CLI sign-in uses a browser device flow. No card, phone or ID document is asked for, and no card payments are taken during the preview.

reliability_note: The offer is in preview: pricing is not charged, sign-up and several features are marked Coming soon, cold starts can return 503 with Retry-After, and the timeout action runs about a minute after the deadline. Preview values may change before general availability.
confidence_note: All rates, limits, the egress gate and the sign-in methods are quoted from Anona Labs' own preview documentation read on 2026-11-24.
